C.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (ac+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number n as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion
Only reducing/simplifying a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and generate equivalent fractions by scaling numerators and denominators.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator for unlike denominators
A step converts fractions to equivalent forms with the chosen common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed
Only subtracting numerators after denominators are already matched

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two fractions (or mixed/whole numbers after rewriting) by subtracting numerators over a common denominator and handling zero/whole-number results.
inclusion_criteria: A step performs subtraction once denominators match (including same-denominator cases)
A step subtracts whole and fractional parts or subtracts identical fractions to get 0
exclusion_criteria: Only converting forms (mixed-to-improper or common denominator) without performing the subtraction
Only simplifying/reducing the final fraction without doing the subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or rewrite an improper fraction as a mixed number or integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by a common factor (e.g., 21/12 to 7/4)
A step states a fraction is already in lowest terms
A step rewrites an improper fraction as a mixed number or simplifies to an integer (e.g., 3/3 = 1)
exclusion_criteria: Only performing the subtraction without any reduction or form change
Only finding a common denominator or converting to improper fractions

B.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and generate equivalent fractions by scaling numerators and denominators.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator for unlike denominators
A step converts fractions to equivalent forms with the chosen common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed
Only subtracting numerators once denominators already match

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers by subtracting numerators over a common denominator (including cases yielding 0 or 1).
inclusion_criteria: A step performs subtraction of two fractions with the same denominator
A step subtracts after converting to a common denominator or improper fractions
exclusion_criteria: Only converting forms (mixed to improper, or to common denominator) without performing the subtraction
Only reducing/simplifying the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or express an equivalent final form (integer or mixed number) consistent with the computed value.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step rewrites an improper fraction as a mixed number or identifies an integer result (e.g., 8/8 = 1)
exclusion_criteria: Only performing subtraction without any reduction or final-form conversion
Only finding a common denominator or converting mixed numbers prior to subtraction

A.domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction (e.g., 3 = 15/5 or 2 = 16/8) to enable subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion
Only reducing/simplifying a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) to rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator for unlike denominators
A step scales numerator and denominator to create equivalent fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing unlike denominators

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed with a common denominator (including subtracting whole and fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a shared denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts mixed numbers by separating whole and fractional parts and combining results
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting numbers (conversion/common denominator) without performing the subtraction
Only simplifying/reducing the final fraction without doing the subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or express it in an acceptable final form (integer or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step identifies a fraction as already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or to an integer (e.g., 8/8 = 1)
exclusion_criteria: Any step that only performs the subtraction without simplification or final-form conversion
Any step that only finds a common denominator or converts mixed numbers prior to subtraction
